verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents OpenAI API compatibility: existing apps switch by changing only the API key, base URL, and model ID. It also supports the standard OpenAI image_url content shape, streaming, tool calling, and structured outputs, so an agent can swap providers without provider-specific code. Community reports add some friction: a 422 wrong_api_format error when routed through claude-code-router, and Cursor integration described as patchy in the past before official support arrived. The 422 is a single integration error that may originate in the router, so it is not concrete enough to dispute the documented compatibility. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), a documented list of unsupported or divergent chat-completions parameters, and independent hands-on confirmation of clean mid-workflow provider switching.
